name: VF-based Point Cloud Initialization
definition: An initialization method that converts NeRF representations into point clouds using Viewshed Fields, then uses standard point cloud registration algorithms (like FPFH + RANSAC) to find the initial transformation.
summary: VF-based Point Cloud Initialization converts NeRFs into sparse point clouds using Viewshed Fields for sampling, then uses geometric registration to align scenes, avoiding iterative photometric alignment.
